name: PD · Watcher
description: Hourly: resolves the latest version of each enabled pd_watch product, records baselines on first sighting, starts a PD Orchestrator run for new versions.

parameters.formTitle: Patch diff: check one product now
parameters.formDescription: Resolves the latest version of one pd_watch product (enabled or not) and starts a diff if it is new. First sighting only records a baseline.

values.formSubmittedText: Checking. New versions start a run; results land in #n8n-alerts.

parameters.command:
=P='{{ $json.product }}'
case "$P" in ''|*[!a-z0-9_-]*) echo 'bad product' >&2; exit 1;; esac
if [ '{{ $json.cmd }}' = inbox ]; then
  D="/opt/loot/patchdiff/_inbox/$P"
  mkdir -p "$D"
  ls -1 "$D" | jq -Rsc 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))'
else
  U='{{ $json.source_ref }}'
  case "$U" in https://*) ;; *) echo 'bad url' >&2; exit 1;; esac
  case "$U" in *[!A-Za-z0-9._/:@-]*) echo 'bad url' >&2; exit 1;; esac
  GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 timeout 120 git -c protocol.file.allow=never ls-remote --tags --refs "$U" | awk '{print $2}' | sed 's#^refs/tags/##' | jq -Rsc 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))'
fi

nodeGroups.name: Resolve latest version
nodeGroups.description: Pull versions out of the source response, version_regex filter, semver-aware max, compare with pd_versions.
